notes: Pay with a contactless card or Oyster for a daily cap (~9 GBP). Buses are cheaper than the Tube and the upper deck has views. Take the Elizabeth Line to Heathrow.
The big museums are free (British Museum, Tate, Natural History Museum, V&A). The Tower, Westminster Abbey and St Paul's charge entry, and online tickets are cheaper.
Summer temperatures are 20-25°C, but rain is possible. Enjoy parks and river trips in summer, with daylight lasting until 21:30.
Pub culture: order at the bar and don't tip. Restaurants may add a 12.5% service charge.
Borough Market is closed on Mondays; Portobello is a Saturday market and Columbia Road a Sunday one.
Reserve for Sunday roast. Pie and mash, fish and chips and Dishoom are London classics.

transit.name: Oyster / Contactless
transit.why_chosen: The cheapest option thanks to the daily cap on the Tube, buses, DLR and trains. A contactless card does the same job.
transit.coverage: Tüm TfL ağı: Tube, otobüs, Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line
transit.where_to_buy: Metro istasyonları; ya da kendi temassız kartını kullan

stops.name: Westminster Abbey
stops.tips: The royal coronation church. Book tickets online (~30 GBP) and arrive at 09:30 to avoid a queue at the entrance.

stops.name: Big Ben & Houses of Parliament
stops.tips: Get the classic photo from Westminster Bridge. Parliament tours are booked separately.

stops.name: Borough Market
stops.tips: London's food market: try the Kappacasein raclette and a Bread Ahead doughnut, and eat lunch standing up.

stops.name: Tate Modern
stops.tips: Modern art in a former power station. Entry is free, and the 10th-floor viewing terrace has great views.

stops.name: South Bank Walk
stops.tips: Follow the Thames from the Millennium Bridge to the London Eye, past street performers and a book market.

backups.name: Padella Borough
backups.tips: Handmade pasta. Join the queue through the app.

backups.name: London Eye
backups.tips: The observation wheel. Book online and go at sunset.

stops.name: Tower of London
stops.tips: The Crown Jewels and a Beefeater tour. Enter at the 09:00 opening and head straight for the jewels. Online ~37 GBP.

stops.name: Tower Bridge
stops.tips: Walk across the bridge. The glass-floored walkway needs a separate ticket (~13 GBP).

stops.name: St Dunstan in the East
stops.tips: The garden ruins of a bombed church, a hidden corner of the city.

stops.name: Leadenhall Market
stops.tips: A Victorian market hall (seen in Harry Potter). Have a pub lunch here.

stops.name: St Paul's Cathedral
stops.tips: Wren's dome. Climb 528 steps to the Golden Gallery for the view.

backups.name: Sky Garden
backups.tips: The free garden terrace at the Walkie Talkie. Reserve online in advance.

backups.name: The Dickens Inn St Katharine Docks
backups.tips: A marina pub next to Tower Bridge. Order the fish and chips.

stops.name: British Museum
stops.tips: The Rosetta Stone and the Parthenon marbles. Free entry, opens at 10:00, and don't miss the Great Court.

stops.name: Dishoom Covent Garden
stops.tips: A Bombay-style café. Order the black daal and bacon naan; expect a 20-minute queue.

stops.name: Covent Garden
stops.tips: Street performances on the Piazza and the Apple Market.

stops.name: Soho & Carnaby Street
stops.tips: Boutiques and Chinatown, plus Berwick Street Market.

stops.name: The French House Soho
stops.tips: Soho's literary pub, with a tradition of serving half pints.

backups.name: National Gallery
backups.tips: Van Gogh and Turner on Trafalgar Square. Free entry; an alternative to the museum.

backups.name: Bao Soho
backups.tips: Taiwanese bao buns, quick and famous.

days.theme: Notting Hill, Kensington and Hyde Park

stops.name: Portobello Road Market
stops.tips: The antiques market runs on Saturdays (other days only the shops are open). Look out for the pastel houses of Notting Hill.

stops.name: Kensington Palace Gardens
stops.tips: The gardens of Kensington Palace and the Princess Diana memorial. Entry to the palace itself is ~24 GBP.

stops.name: The Churchill Arms
stops.tips: A pub covered in flowers, with Thai food inside. A London classic.

stops.name: Natural History Museum
stops.tips: Dinosaur skeletons and a blue whale. Free entry; head for Hintze Hall.

stops.name: Hyde Park & Serpentine
stops.tips: The Serpentine lake and Speakers' Corner. Rent a boat in summer.

backups.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
backups.tips: A design museum. Free entry, with a café in the courtyard.

backups.name: Ottolenghi Notting Hill
backups.tips: A display of salads and pastries.

stops.name: Camden Market
stops.tips: 1,000 stalls selling street food and punk-vintage clothes, including Stables Market.

stops.name: Camden Lock Street Food
stops.tips: The market's food court, with cuisines from around the world.

stops.name: Regent's Canal Walk
stops.tips: Follow the canal from Camden to Little Venice, past narrowboats.

stops.name: Primrose Hill
stops.tips: The best free view of the London skyline.

stops.name: Regent's Park Rose Garden
stops.tips: Queen Mary's Gardens, with 12,000 roses in summer.

backups.name: ZSL London Zoo
backups.tips: A zoo in Regent's Park, good if you're travelling with children.

stops.name: Uber Boat Thames Clipper
stops.tips: The river bus from Westminster to Greenwich (Oyster accepted). You pass under the bridges.

stops.name: Cutty Sark
stops.tips: A tea clipper. Walk along the deck.

stops.name: Greenwich Market
stops.tips: A weekend market of handicrafts and street food.

stops.name: Royal Observatory Greenwich
stops.tips: The Prime Meridian line and a planetarium. There are views from the top of the park.

stops.name: Greenwich Park
stops.tips: From the hill you can see Canary Wharf and the river. Good for a picnic.

backups.name: National Maritime Museum
backups.tips: A free maritime museum, an alternative to the observatory.

days.theme: Sunday roast and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Columbia Road Flower Market
stops.tips: A flower market on Sundays (on other days, street cafés only). In the East End.

stops.name: Brick Lane
stops.tips: Street art, vintage shops and bagels (Beigel Bake is open 24 hours).

stops.name: The Cat and Mutton Broadway Market
stops.tips: One of London's best Sunday roasts. Reserve for Sunday; on other days there's a pub menu.

stops.name: Liverpool Street Station
stops.tips: Heathrow is 45 minutes away on the Elizabeth Line. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Beigel Bake Brick Lane
backups.tips: Salt beef bagel, a quick farewell bite.

backups.name: Spitalfields Market
backups.tips: An indoor market, an alternative to Brick Lane.
